script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

Title: A New Leaf

FADE IN:

EXT. SUBURBAN NEIGHBORHOOD - DAY

A picturesque suburban neighborhood with well-manicured lawns and colorful houses.

NARRATOR (voiceover)
(sincere, optimistic tone)
In life, we all make mistakes. But what if you could start anew, with a clean slate?

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

JANE (early 40s, disheveled, wearing old clothing) is preparing breakfast for her family.

DAVID (early 40s, wearing a suit) enters the kitchen, looking frustrated.

DAVID
(shouting)
How many times do I have to tell you, Jane, the kids need a stable home environment!

JANE
(sighs)
I know, David. I'm trying. But it's not that easy.

David rubs his forehead, clearly tired and exasperated.

DAVID
(softening)
I just want what's best for us and the kids.

JANE
(nods)
Me too.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jane sits on the couch, staring at the TV with blank expression. The phone rings. She hesitates, then answers.

JANE
(worried)
Hello?

SISTER MARY (late 50s, kind, nurturing) speaks over the phone.

SISTER MARY
Jane, I've heard about your struggles. I have an opportunity for you.

EXT. COMMUNITY CENTER - DAY

Jane, now dressed in neat clothing, is greeted by SISTER MARY at the community center.

SISTER MARY
This is the New Beginnings Program. It offers job training, education, and counseling for individuals seeking a fresh start.

INT. CLASSROOM - DAY

Jane sits at a table with other participants in the program, learning new skills from a TEACHER.

TEACHER
(encouraging)
Remember, everyone, we all have unique talents and abilities. You'll shine in your new careers.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

David enters the kitchen, surprised to find it clean and well-stocked. Jane, now confident and dressed professionally, greets him with a smile.

JANE
David, I've enrolled in the New Beginnings Program. I'm going to get a job and provide for our family.

David is taken aback, but ultimately proud and supportive.

DAVID
(smiling)
Jane, I'm so proud of you.

INT. FAMILY DINNER - NIGHT

The family gathers around the dinner table, smiling and laughing. Jane serves a delicious meal, beaming with pride.

NARRATOR (voiceover)
With a new leaf, comes a new beginning.

FADE OUT.
